new-arrival-smart-52.title: New Arrival Smart-52
new-arrival-smart-52.content:
Experience the Next Evolution in Card Printing
Introducing the SMART-52 Series ID Card Printer—re-engineered
from the ground up to deliver faster performance, smarter control,
and a superior printing experience.
Building upon the proven reliability of IDP’s best-selling SMART-51,
the SMART-52 combines next-generation hardware with powerful
innovations for professional-grade ID card issuance.
Based on a new multi-core CPU and 8x larger RAM, the SMART-52
provides 30% faster printing speed and a uniform, stable, and
optimal print quality.
The SMART-52’s touchscreen LCD allows for complete, direct control
over all functions on the printer, eliminating the need for a PC or
external devices.
The extended ribbon capacity, featuring a 40% larger ribbon (350
cards per roll, YMCKO), reduces ribbon changeovers and lowers the
total issuance cost.
The SMART-52's multi-platform utility ensures consistent, simplified
card issuance and management across any OS environment
